RETURNED.text: The parcel came back. Stock is not restored automatically: check the bottles first, then use “Return to stock” on the order page.

restock.title: Return to stock
restock.text: The parcel came back. Check each bottle, then choose how many are fine to sell again. They go back into your stock.

restock.nothing: Choose at least one bottle to put back.
restock.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
